q: We presented VibeTrace, an interactive trace visualization and intervention system for human—coding agent collaboration.
r: IC1: a trace visualization and intervention tool, not an evaluation of SDD, context files or agents.

q: We introduced MemUse, a framework for evaluating memory deliveries through their context, use, and observed consequences.
r: Include: evaluates memory delivered to coding agents (mini-swe-agent, codex, claude) with benefit, cost and harm measures.

q: SKILL-USE pairs 79 real skills with 177 executable tasks across nine domains
r: IC1: skill-use benchmark over general agent tasks in nine domains, not software development.

q: We systematically collect and analyze 11,497 unique SE-related skills from public repositories and marketplaces
r: Include: empirical study of SE agent skills (context mechanism) incl. how they are evaluated.

q: This paper proposes a new software engineering task, namely natural language to code repository (NL2Repo).
r: IC1: prompted or fine-tuned code LLM pipeline for repository generation, no coding agent.

q: This paper offers a thorough review of 291 benchmarks
r: IC1: survey of LLM benchmarks across all SE tasks, not centred on coding agents.

q: We propose ProjectGen, a multi-agent three-stage framework for project-level code generation
r: EC5: main contribution is a new technique on its own dataset, no new evaluation method.
